NOTES - VRC box (x2 identical: front FL/FR, rear RL/RR)
1. 6061-T6 billet body + lid. Stock est.: body 95 x 80 x 42, lid 95 x 55 x 8 (plate).
2. Seal: AS568-039 O-ring (ID 69.57, W 1.78; Parker Table 9-1) in body-rim face groove.
NBR 70, Parker N0674-70 2-039 (Dan E4). Lid closes metal-to-metal on the rim.
3. Lid: 4x M3 x 12 ISO 10642 A2 countersunk; tapped holes outside the O-ring.
4. Connectors: 2x CNLINKO LP-16-C05SX-02-101, D18.5/16.5 flat, M18x1.5 rear nut,
1.0 N.m, panel 3.5 (max 4.5) - CNLINKO drawing LP-16-xxxSX-02-1xxx rev A1.
Behind panel 12.6 (derived: A 26.2 - front 13.6). Rear nut OD not published:
D30 counterbore (inside face, as modelled) is a safe allowance - check a sample nut.
5. Electronics: OpenLogicEFI Dual VR Conditioner (DetonationEMS, Dan E2) held by a
3D-printed holder v2 on the box floor (Dan M9, R126): one PA12 block, board flush in a pocket
with 4 snap tabs, wires soldered on the board top. 2x M6 x 14 ISO 10642 A2 TX30 csk (Lemu 2990806014).
6. Board holder: printed PA12, ST185_VRC_board_holder_PA12 (print/ .3mf / .stl / .step).
7. Mount on 4x M6 nylon screws (SHIELD-RULES: box mounts on nylon) - Dan E5.
8. BREAK SHARP EDGES 0.2-0.5 EXCEPT O-RING / SEAL FACES. No coating on rim / groove / lid seal face.
9. Inside D30 counterbores stay as modelled (Dan, 2026-10-14). 3D printed: as modelled.
Machined: back-counterbore tool through the D-hole, or a second setup on that wall.
10. v2 holder (2026-10-16): the 4 M3 floor bosses of R108 are removed (suppressed in Fusion).
11. Tab-to-body inside corners R3 (F11). Floor-to-wall inside corners: CUTTER CORNER OK (square end mill).
12. Tab slots 6.6 x 10 (F01). Lid M3: drill 2.5 x 9.5 + 118 deg, thread 8 (F08).
13. N4 (Dan 2026-10-16): holder 2.5 higher (board top z 17.5, 21.5 to the lid); ring over the boss 2.0; block 0.47 from the LP-16 rears.
ST185 VRC ENCLOSURE
Body + lid, O-ring face seal, LP-16 IN / OUT on opposite ends
